encounters.name: Howling Pine Ambush
encounters.introProse: Shadows dart across the snowdrifts! A pack of white wolves emerges with bared yellow fangs.

victoryOutcome.text: The timber wolves scatter into the snowy pines, leaving a prize pelt behind.

encounters.name: Frost Troll on the Ledge
encounters.introProse: Boulders smash across the icy trail! A towering mountain frost troll blocks the glacier pass.

victoryOutcome.text: The mountain frost troll collapses across the icy scree. You harvest its prized thickhide.

encounters.name: Infested Shaft Nine Frost Troll
encounters.introProse: A savage mountain frost troll charges from the collapsed timber gallery, swinging a club of petrified pine!

victoryOutcome.text: The mountain frost troll crashes into the rubble. You harvest its prized thickhide for the Iron Covenant.

encounters.name: The Crypt Lord Awakens
encounters.introProse: The heavy granite sarcophagus shatters! Chieftain Skallagrim steps forth with burning blue eyes and a raised waraxe.

victoryOutcome.text: With a final hollow curse, Chieftain Skallagrim collapses into a heap of ancient bone and rusted iron. His ancestral torque slips loose onto the crypt flagstones.

addJournalChronicle.title: Slumber of Skallagrim
addJournalChronicle.text: Put Chieftain Skallagrim the Undying to rest in the depths of the Weeping Barrow.

encounters.name: Wrath of Mount Wyrmfang
encounters.introProse: The caldera basalt shudders and splits! Vyr the Frost Wyrm spreads its colossal wings and roars with the fury of a thousand winters.

victoryOutcome.text: The ancient Frost Wyrm collapses with a world-shaking roar. The celestial monoliths ignite, sealing Vyr within the frozen core of Mount Wyrmfang once more!

addJournalChronicle.title: The Quelling of Mount Wyrmfang
addJournalChronicle.text: Defeated and resealed the ancient Frost Wyrm Vyr atop Mount Wyrmfang with the three Star-Keys of High King Valen.

encounters.name: Pack of the Howling Cavern
encounters.introProse: A scarred silver-backed alpha wolf leaps from atop a pile of splintered wagon planks, snarling beside Astrid's torn trade sledge!

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: With the alpha wolf slain, the remaining pack scatters into the pines. Beneath the overturned sledge sits Astrid's intact fur crate!

encounters.name: Ambush in the Peat Reeds
encounters.introProse: Black bog water erupts beside the sunken flagstones as a venom-spined Bog Stalker lunges at your heels!

transcript.speaker: Victory
transcript.text: The Bog Stalker sinks beneath the dark reeds, leaving behind an intact venom sac.

encounters.name: The Canal Cult Courier
encounters.introProse: As you haul the wax-sealed buoy from the bog, a hooded Vyr-Sworn Zealot rises from the fog with an obsidian ritual blade drawn! 'The Wyrm's tribute is not for Watch lapdogs!'

transcript.speaker: Secret Discovery
transcript.text: From the fallen zealot's oiled satchel you seize the Obsidian Cult Manifest, naming the corrupt Watch liaison and the Wyrmfang supply chain!

encounters.name: Awakened Silver-Kin Sentinel
encounters.introProse: Tremors from Mount Wyrmfang have cracked the containment runes on an ancient dwarven forge-automaton. Its furnace eyes flare crimson as it blocks the Star-Iron seam!

transcript.speaker: Victory
transcript.text: The Runebound Sentinel powers down in a hiss of steam, exposing a gleaming cluster of Star-Iron Ore and Glacial Quartz!

encounters.name: Guardian of the Forgotten Lineage
encounters.introProse: Prying open the false glacial wall releases a century of trapped frost. A shrieking Frostmere Ice Wraith materializes around a battered iron diadem!

transcript.speaker: Secret Discovery
transcript.text: The Ice Wraith dissolves into sparkling snow. Resting upon a velvet cushion behind the false wall lies the Crown of the Rime-King and Valen's suppressed treaty!
